description: Land Title Settlement Department - Abagahawewa, Nochchiyagama D/S Division, Anuradhapura District - Cad. Map No. 110279 (23/331)
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels, including detailed schedules with parcel numbers, extents, ownership details (primarily "The State"), and land classifications. The content falls squarely within the Land Gazette category as it involves land registrations, property ownership determinations, and land title settlements.
